semiconductor_relevance: High — HUG Power Co., Ltd. provides specialized cleaning equipment crucial for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: HUG Power Co., Ltd. develops and sells chemical-free cleaning equipment for the semiconductor industry, focusing on steam two-fluid cleaning and high-concentration ozonated water systems. These technologies are designed to enhance cleaning performance while reducing production costs and environmental impact.
